about: What a field's projection means, in words: the same cases run against Outlook (Ruby, the daily digest) and lib/outlook.ts (the field page and dashboard), so the two can't drift apart. Each case's summary is merged over base; expected is the whole outlook, or null.

cases.name: says when to irrigate, how much, and how many forecast scenarios agree

expected.headline: Irrigate by Sun, Jul 12
expected.detail: Projected to reach the irrigation point in 2 days, when about 1.30 in would refill the root zone to field capacity.
expected.chance: 15 of 30 forecast scenarios reach it by then.

cases.name: says tomorrow, and names the target when there is one

expected.headline: Irrigate by Sat, Jul 11
expected.detail: Projected to reach its target tomorrow, when about 0.70 in would refill the root zone to field capacity.
expected.chance: 3 of 30 forecast scenarios reach it by then.

cases.name: isn't urgent beyond the lead days, and leaves out the scenarios for a day past the ensemble

expected.headline: Irrigate by Wed, Jul 15
expected.detail: Projected to reach the irrigation point in 5 days, when about 2.05 in would refill the root zone to field capacity.
